facts.text: Thompson Savannah sits along the Savannah River's edge where the Historic District meets the Eastern Wharf.
facts.excerpt: unwind in upscale sophistication along the Savannah River’s edge where the Historic District meets the Eastern Wharf

facts.text: The hotel's address is 201 Port Street, Savannah, Georgia.
facts.excerpt: 201 Port Street, Savannah, GA 31401, United States of America

facts.text: Bar Julian is the hotel's rooftop bar, with sweeping views of the Savannah River.
facts.excerpt: Above it all, with sweeping views of the Savannah River, Bar Julian delivers a creative Mediterranean-inspired menu.

facts.text: Bar Julian is the tallest rooftop bar in Savannah's modern history.
facts.excerpt: Bar Julian is the tallest rooftop bar in Savannah's modern history

facts.text: Bar Julian serves a Mediterranean-inspired menu including breakfast, bar snacks and locally-inspired pizzas.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy elevated breakfast options, bar snacks, and locally-inspired pizzas.

facts.text: Fleeting, the hotel's signature restaurant, serves elevated coastal Southern cuisine with an ever-evolving menu built on hyperlocal ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Think elevated coastal Southern cuisine with an ever-evolving menu that celebrates hyperlocal ingredients and blends global flavors with regional classics.

facts.text: Fleeting's shareable dishes include wood-grilled oysters with chartreuse-lemongrass butter.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy shareable dishes like pork belly, green tomatoes, and wood-grilled oysters with chartreuse-lemongrass butter

facts.text: Stevedore Bakery, on the ground floor, showcases local Southern farmers and partners such as PERC Coffee.
facts.excerpt: The menu celebrates the region's flavors through local partners like PERC Coffee to create an iconic neighborhood staple.

facts.text: Rooms have a midcentury modern design with rainfall showers and floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Each is outfitted with thoughtful amenities, including a rainfall shower and floor-to-ceiling windows.

facts.text: City-inspired botanical patterns, curated artwork and herringbone wood floors decorate the rooms.
facts.excerpt: City-inspired botanical patterns, curated artwork and herringbone wood floors add an artistic touch

facts.text: Rooms come with custom 400-thread count Sferra linens and D.S. & Durga bath products.
facts.excerpt:
Custom 400-thread count Sferra linens
  - D.S. & Durga bath products

facts.text: Rooms look out over the Savannah River or the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: Take in sweeping views of the Savannah River or the city skyline from our boutique, midcentury modern hotel.

facts.text: The pool deck has a splash pool with in-water loungers and private cabanas with daybeds.
facts.excerpt: Recline in the splash pool’s in-water loungers that strike the perfect balance between refreshing and relaxation, or reserve one of our private cabanas that provide shade and exclusivity with daybeds overlooking the pool.

facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes, and courtesy hotel bikes are available for exploring Savannah.
facts.excerpt: courtesy hotel bikes are available to explore Savannah on two wheels

facts.text: Dogs of all breeds and sizes are welcome at no additional charge; cats cannot be accommodated.
facts.excerpt: We warmly welcome dogs of all breeds and sizes, with no additional charge. We are unable to accommodate cats.

facts.text: Woodhouse Spa is steps from the hotel, offering treatments and infrared sauna experiences.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in refined relaxation at Woodhouse Spa, steps from Thompson Savannah. Reconnect and restore with luxurious treatments, infrared sauna experiences

facts.text: Taste of Thompson dinner parties offer chef-curated four-course meals or cocktail parties built on hyper-local ingredients, with a minimum of 8 guests.
facts.excerpt: Celebrating hyper-local ingredients with your choice of a four-course meal or cocktail party with paired bites, every detail will be tailored to your preferences.

facts.text: The hotel is 11 miles from Savannah/Hilton Head International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Travel with ease to our downtown hotel, just 11 miles from the Savannah airport

facts.text: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance.

facts.text: Bar Julian is 21 and over after 10pm.
facts.excerpt: 21+ after 10pm

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards 2022 and 2025.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2022, 2025
